verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents prebuilt, vendor-maintained triggers/actions and OAuth/key-based auth for 3,000+ APIs and 10,000+ tools, corroborated by an independent llms.txt probe confirming 3,223 apps, plus community sentiment comparing it favorably to Zapier for integration breadth. Missing for 10: no independent audit verifying integration quality/maintenance freshness across the full catalog.
